one_line: Maratha commander who led the 1737–1739 campaign that captured Vasai from the Portuguese on the Konkan coast.

appearance.age_look: Early 40s, medium height with a sturdy, disciplined build and the presence of an experienced field commander.
appearance.face: Oval face with a calm, wheatish-brown complexion, neatly trimmed black moustache that curves slightly downward, faint lines at the eyes from campaigning, and a steady, assessing gaze; default expression is composed and focused, hinting at tactical calculation rather than rage.
appearance.hair: Black hair oiled and tied back into a small, low bun at the nape, mostly hidden under a deep-red Maratha-style turban (paga) with a slightly forward tilt and a narrow gold border along the edge, no crest or plume.
appearance.costume: He wears a long-sleeved white cotton angarkha (overlapping front-tied robe) reaching just below the knees with a subtle fine-stripe weave, over a fitted pale-cream cotton jama-like inner tunic; around his waist is a broad saffron cotton patka (sash) wrapped twice and knotted slightly to the left, with its ends hanging; his lower body is clad in dark indigo dhoti-style trousers tied in the Maharashtrian fashion, the pleats tucked for riding and marching; on his shoulders he has a sleeveless, slightly padded, mid-thigh-length quilted cotton coat (zaghul-like war coat) in muted olive green with simple vertical stitching and no flashy decoration; his feet are in brown leather Kolhapuri-style sandals with closed toes suitable for campaign use; he wears minimal jewellery—small plain gold studs in the ears and a single black-thread armlet on his right arm, plus a simple wooden tulsi-bead mala just visible at the neck.
appearance.signature: A single, slightly curved steel talwar with a brass hilt and disc pommel, sheathed in a plain brown leather scabbard hanging from a dark-brown leather baldric that crosses his chest diagonally over the angarkha, often held in his left hand while his right hand holds a folded palm-leaf dispatch roll tucked into his sash.

ref_desc: Chimaji Appa is a sturdy early-40s Maratha commander with a wheatish oval face, black tied-back hair under a deep-red turban, white angarkha over dark indigo dhoti, olive quilted war coat, saffron waist-sash, and a brass-hilted talwar with brown leather scabbard on a chest-crossing baldric.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Chimaji Appa as a dignified Maratha commander: an early-40s, medium-height man with a sturdy build, wheatish-brown oval face, calm focused eyes, and a neat black moustache, his black hair tied back and mostly hidden under a deep-red Maratha turban with a narrow gold border. Show him fully clothed in a long-sleeved white cotton angarkha that overlaps in front and reaches just below the knees, over a pale-cream inner tunic, with a broad saffron cotton sash wrapped twice around his waist and knotted slightly to the left. His lower body is covered by dark indigo dhoti-style trousers tied in Maharashtrian fashion with pleats arranged for marching, and over his torso he wears a sleeveless, mid-thigh-length quilted cotton war coat in muted olive green with visible vertical stitching and no ornate decoration. Put plain brown leather closed-toe sandals on his feet, small gold studs in his ears, a simple black-thread armlet on his right arm, and a modest wooden bead mala at his neck. A dark-brown leather baldric crosses diagonally over his chest, supporting a slightly curved steel talwar with a brass hilt and disc pommel in a plain brown leather scabbard at his left hip; in his other hand, include a small rolled palm-leaf or paper dispatch partially tucked into his saffron sash to suggest logistical command. Use a restrained color palette of white, saffron, dark indigo, olive green, deep red, and brown leather, and present front, side, and back views to clearly show the consistent turban, facial features, garments, sash, baldric, and weapon placement in a clean historical-action anime style.
